svg.title: follows from the uniform logarithm envelopes and the old forced envelopes. In a nonzero term, every attachment meets a flagged site. The exact inventory coverage of its old forced set puts that site in an old forced inventory, hence also in its support. Therefore each connected component of the selected atom supports contains an old forced label; no free attachment component occurs. Components are precisely the new labels, with disjoint supports and inventories covering the original flagged set. Conversely a permitted set of new labels has disjoint atom sets, since every atom support is nonempty; their union recovers the original old forced set and attachment subset. The exact inventory condition also implies the original local inventory conditions: another disjoint forced support cannot supply a flag within the given support. Thus decomposition and union are inverse on all nonzero terms, with identical products. This proves
